description:
Use this when the user wants to know what the editor offers: "which caption styles are there", "any glitch
transitions". kind: caption_templates, fonts, caption_animations, effects, transitions, filters, text_styles,
text_effects, text_animations, stickers, sounds, music, formats, shapes or templates (saved styles). The names
are what style_clip, add_to_clip and edit_clip take; premium marks paid ones.
Not for: changing a clip or clipping presets (list_clipping_presets). Free and read only.

kind.description: Which list, one of the kinds named in the tool description.

limit.description: Most items to return, up to 300.

query.description: Word to match in a name or group, e.g. "glitch". Empty = all.
